headline: U.S. Provided Intelligence and Drones for Venezuelan Rebel Camp Strike
summary: Four U.S. officials stated that Washington provided Venezuela with intelligence and drones for an October 30 strike on an ELN rebel camp.
why: Geopolitical military interventions and regional security cooperation affect political stability and security risk assessments in Latin America.

impacts.name: Venezuela
impacts.why: Military operations against rebel camps involve cross-border security dynamics.
